overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus 4-Person Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious, rejuvenating retreat right in your home. Designed for wellness, it features 9 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels that promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood, this sauna is perfect for indoor spaces like basements or fitness rooms. Enjoy the added luxury of an interior chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity, making every session a personalized escape.
